name: EOSM MNT-0002 Shallow Execution Freshness Follow-up

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eosm/fix-eosv-shallow-execution-freshness-bootstrap

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  EOS_ACTOR: chatgpt

jobs:
  repair:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Enter exact maintenance baseline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          BASE_SHA="12f6afa239bcb6a44909902ec8469dd74f7b0ba6"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$BASE_SHA"
          git reset --hard "$BASE_SHA"
          test ! -e .github/workflows/eosm-shallow-execution-freshness-bootstrap.yml
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

      - name: Make execution workspace freshness history-independent
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path

          verifier=Path('tools/eos/verification_v2.py')
          text=verifier.read_text()
          start=text.index('def workspace_hash(cwd: Path, baseline: str) -> str:\n')
          end=text.index('\n\nSOURCE_EXCLUDED_PATHS = (', start)
          replacement='''def workspace_hash(cwd: Path, baseline: str) -> str:\n    """Hash execution-relevant current source independently of Git history depth.\n\n    The immutable execution baseline remains a separate fingerprint payload field.\n    Generated EOS/evidence/machine outputs are excluded by source_content_hash().\n    """\n    _ = baseline\n    return source_content_hash(cwd)\n'''
          verifier.write_text(text[:start]+replacement+text[end:])

          test=Path('scripts/test-eosv-evidence-freshness.py')
          text=test.read_text()
          anchor='''        assert (\n            "source fingerprint changed" not in projection_row["issues"]\n        ), projection_row\n\n        # Real execution-source drift must still be detected relative to\n'''
          insert='''        assert (\n            "source fingerprint changed" not in projection_row["issues"]\n        ), projection_row\n\n        # Execution-bound freshness must also be identical in a shallow clone\n        # where the immutable baseline object is intentionally unavailable.\n        shallow = root.parent / "shallow"\n        run(\n            "git",\n            "clone",\n            "--depth",\n            "1",\n            f"file://{root}",\n            str(shallow),\n            cwd=root.parent,\n        )\n        assert run(\n            "git", "cat-file", "-e", f"{baseline}^{{commit}}", cwd=shallow, check=False\n        ).returncode != 0\n        shallow_exec = shallow / ".eos" / "executions.tsv"\n        shallow_rows = list(csv.DictReader(shallow_exec.open(), delimiter="\\t"))\n        shallow_rows[0]["worktree"] = ""\n        write_tsv(shallow_exec, module.EXEC_FIELDS, shallow_rows)\n        shallow_module = load_verifier_module(shallow)\n        shallow_hash, shallow_payload = shallow_module.source_fingerprint(\n            "WP-TEST-0001", "EXEC-TEST-0001"\n        )\n        assert shallow_hash == execution_initial, shallow_payload\n        assert shallow_payload["baseline"] == baseline\n\n        # Real execution-source drift must still be detected relative to\n'''
          assert text.count(anchor)==1
          test.write_text(text.replace(anchor,insert,1))

          mnt=Path('engineering/maintenance/MNT-0002.md')
          text=mnt.read_text()
          marker='## Closure criterion\n'
          addition='''## Third root cause discovered in pull-request CI\n\nPR #194 proved the corrected execution evidence remained fresh on a full-history checkout, but GitHub repository CI evaluates a depth-1 synthetic merge checkout where EXEC-0004's historical baseline object is absent. The prior `workspace_hash()` implementation attempted `git diff <baseline>` without checking that failure, producing a different hash based on local history availability.\n\nExecution freshness must be a function of the current execution-relevant source tree plus the immutable baseline identifier already carried separately in the fingerprint payload. It must not require the baseline Git object to exist locally.\n\n## Shallow-clone verification\n\n- [ ] A depth-1 clone without the execution baseline object produces the same execution-bound source fingerprint as a full-history clone of the same source tree, while real source drift still stales evidence.\n\n'''
          assert marker in text and 'Third root cause discovered in pull-request CI' not in text
          mnt.write_text(text.replace(marker,addition+marker,1))
          PY

      - name: Verify history-independent freshness
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 -m py_compile tools/eos/verification_v2.py scripts/test-eosv-evidence-freshness.py
          python3 scripts/test-eosv-evidence-freshness.py
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          p=Path('engineering/maintenance/MNT-0002.md')
          text=p.read_text()
          item='- [ ] A depth-1 clone without the execution baseline object produces the same execution-bound source fingerprint as a full-history clone of the same source tree, while real source drift still stales evidence.'
          assert item in text
          p.write_text(text.replace(item,item.replace('[ ]','[x]'),1))
          PY

          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0001 --profile wp
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Assert scope and publish
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          FINAL_BRANCH="eosm/fix-eosv-shallow-execution-freshness"
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import csv
          verifier=Path('tools/eos/verification_v2.py').read_text()
          assert 'return source_content_hash(cwd)' in verifier
          mnt=Path('engineering/maintenance/MNT-0002.md').read_text()
          assert '**State:** VERIFYING' in mnt
          assert '- [x] A depth-1 clone without the execution baseline object' in mnt
          row=next(r for r in csv.DictReader(open('.eos/maintenance.tsv'),delimiter='\t') if r['id']=='MNT-0002')
          assert row['status']=='VERIFYING', row
          PY
          allowed='^(tools/eos/verification_v2\.py|scripts/test-eosv-evidence-freshness\.py|engineering/maintenance/MNT-0002\.md|\.eos/|machine/|engineering/evidence/)'
          unexpected="$(git diff --name-only | grep -Ev "$allowed" || true)"
          test -z "$unexpected" || { printf 'Unexpected scope:\n%s\n' "$unexpected" >&2; exit 1; }

          git config user.name 'PMB CI'
          git config user.email 'ci@pmb.test'
          git add -A
          git commit -m 'fix(eosv): make execution freshness history-independent'
          python3 scripts/test-eosv-evidence-freshness.py
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "12f6afa239bcb6a44909902ec8469dd74f7b0ba6"
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$FINAL_BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Final branch already exists" >&2; exit 1
          fi
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$FINAL_BRANCH"
